answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue gains without measurable retention harm. Memory 44 supports qualified pipeline quality in enterprise, though it omits realized revenue and retention. Memory 73 reports strong SMB acquisition and revenue lift, but omits longer-term retention, margin, and durability risks from discounts. Memories 31 and 86 show durable or broad activation and adoption improvements, but do not connect them to qualified revenue or retention. Memory 91 is least supported because it reports only improved week-one engagement and more first meaningful actions, with no evidence of durable adoption, revenue, qualification, or retention impact.
